title: Kreativ Core
description: A responsive WordPress theme for journals, blogs, portfolios, and content-led websites.
metaDescription: Explore Kreativ Core, a WordPress theme by KreativWP with editorial homepage templates, dark mode, and Customizer options.
highlights: Sectioned homepage templates and category-driven layouts for publishing
Journal, Studio, and Portfolio design variations with six block patterns
Custom logo, footer options, responsive images, optional dark mode, and related posts
bestFor: Blogs, journals, and portfolios that need a content-focused classic WordPress theme.
researchScope: This product profile describes the theme's public source and documentation. Kreativ Core is developed by KreativWP, so this is not an independent review.
caveats: The public repository identifies its source as version 1.0.22, checked November 23, 2026. Check the WordPress.org review ticket for the directory submission status and test the theme with your own content and plugins.
